item.name: 01. Admissions & Statutory Screening Gate (WAC 246-841A-440(1))
item.description: Covers mandatory student background checks, TB test proof, immunizations, CPR certification, high school verification, statutory disclosures e-signature, and instructor/admin approval gate.

request.description: Student uploads required verification documentation before class entry.
Student e-signs RCW/WAC statutory disclosures (DSHS disqualifying crimes, refund policy, physical demands of nursing).
Student retrieves their application status and verification history.
Program Director / Instructor lists all applications submitted for Cohort 1.
Director approves student admission, automatically activating student cohort enrollment.

item.name: 02. Orientation & Attendance Census (WAC 246-841A-440(2))
item.description: Mandatory zero-credit online orientation module covering platform navigation, academic integrity, attendance policy, and clinical dress code before course unlocking.

request.description: Check whether student has satisfied the orientation prerequisite for cohort 1.
Record completion of mandatory zero-credit orientation checklist.

item.name: 04. Multi-Criteria Rubrics (Explicit User Specification)
item.description: Standardized grading rubrics for discussions and assignments featuring multi-level criteria, scoring scales, cloning, and automated evaluation.

item.name: 4.1 Create Rubric with Criteria & Performance Levels

request.description: Instructor creates standardized rubric.
Query all active discussion rubrics.
Retrieve rubric schema with complete criteria and level hierarchy.
Duplicate rubric and its nested criteria/levels for another cohort.
Calculate weighted score and generate standardized rubric feedback evaluation.

item.name: 07. Active Seat-Time Heartbeat Engine (WAC 246-841A-440(6))
item.description: High-precision active presence monitoring tracking active engagement pulses every 30-60 seconds to satisfy the 60-hour theory mandate.

request.description: Client application pulses heartbeat while student actively consumes educational content.

request.description: Aggregates cumulative seat time across all lessons against the 60-hour theory requirement.
View individual lesson seat-time logs and engagement score history.
Generates regulatory seat-time compliance breakdown for every student in Cohort 1.

item.name: 10. Exam Security & Proctoring (WAC 246-841A-440(9))

Finalizes exam security session with duration and integrity metrics.
Retrieve security audit trail including blur counts and identity verification photos.
Instructor verifies and approves exam session integrity.

request.description: Nurse registers state license and specialized teaching qualifications.
Inspect RN license and verification status.
Program Director approves RN instructor to lead cohorts.
Review all approved instructional staff and their active licensing status.
